newsitem.title: UK: Scot Media buys 9.9 pct in Grampian.
newsitem.headline: Scot Media buys 9.9 pct in Grampian.

text.p: Scottish Media Group Plc said on Tuesday it had bought 3.26 million shares representing 9.9 percent of Grampian Television Plc at 320 pence per share for a total of 10.4 million stg.
The purchase was made after Scottish Media announced details of an agreed buyout of Grampian Television, which valued the target broadcaster at 105.4 million stg at 320 pence a share.
Grampian's share price rose to a new year high of 317 1/2 pence after the details were announced.
Scottish Media will offer 18.3425 new shares in its company and 192 million stg of new Scottish Media convertible unsecured loan stock for every 100 Grampian shares, it said.

The offer price represented a premium of 22 percent over the mid-market closing price of Grampian of 262.5 pence on May 30, 1997 the day prior to the announcement that the companies were in merger talks.
